draw_rect_on_image: draw a rectangle on a uint8 numpy image with a specified color and bounding box
write_text_on_image: write formatted text labels onto a numpy image at a specified location with custom font size
depth_for_vis: transform depth image values from a specified range to normalized 0-255 for visualization
vis_object_poses_rgb: visualize 3D object models in specified poses as an RGB image blended with the input image
vis_object_poses_depth_diff: visualize 3D object poses and compute depth difference between rendered and captured depth maps
